paras: In Orgrimmar’s Cleft of Shadow, Zevrost trains warlocks in fel magic. He guides Horde initiates through summoning rites and the handling of dark artifacts.

In the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar, Zevrost is one of the chief mentors for Horde warlocks in Thrall’s capital. Orcs remain wary of fel magic after their past demonic corruption, so practitioners work under strict watch. Zevrost teaches the discipline needed to command demons without yielding to their corruption. He says fel ruins only those who lack inner strength.

Zevrost guides warlocks beyond spells and curses, opening the way to greater dark undertakings. Initiates seeking advanced implements such as the Orb of Orahil, or the means to summon a fiery Felsteed, often come through his hands. He sends ambitious practitioners to other masters, including Menara Voidrender in the Barrens, so they can push their command of shadow magic to its limits.
